Record Class MultiblockShape.Box

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
fr.robie.machineengine.api.multiblock.MultiblockShape.Box
Record Components:
casing - the block of its edges and corners (and of its anchor)
faces - blocks allowed in its walls (the casing, valves, ports, glass...)
interior - blocks allowed inside (e.g. only air for a tank)
minSize - the smallest outer size on each axis (at least 3)
maxSize - the largest outer size on each axis
width - the outer width and depth it must have, or 0 for any
openTop - no roof: the top layer is part of the interior, walls go round it
controller - a block that must be in the walls exactly once, or null
All Implemented Interfaces:
MultiblockShape
Enclosing interface:
MultiblockShape
public static record MultiblockShape.Box(@NotNull net.kyori.adventure.key.Key casing, @NotNull Set<net.kyori.adventure.key.Key> faces, @NotNull Predicate<net.kyori.adventure.key.Key> interior, int minSize, int maxSize, int width, boolean openTop, @Nullable net.kyori.adventure.key.Key controller) extends Record implements MultiblockShape
A hollow box: frame blocks make its six walls (an open top: five), casings every edge and corner, and its interior holds what interior allows. The anchor is its lowest corner.
